name: OpenHands Agent.step
says: step 先处理待确认行动，再从会话视图组装消息并处理 condensation。
does_not_claim: Agent 对象本身保存所有状态，或压缩等同长期记忆。
example: 长任务先整理会话视图，再继续调用模型。

703:     def _step(
704:         self,
705:         conversation: LocalConversation,
706:         on_event: ConversationCallbackType,
707:         stream: StreamContext,
708:     ) -> None:
709:         state = conversation.state
710:         # Check for pending actions (implicit confirmation)
711:         # and execute them before sampling new actions.
712:         pending_actions = ConversationState.get_unmatched_actions(state.active_branch())
713:         if pending_actions:
714:             logger.info(
715:                 "Confirmation mode: Executing %d pending action(s)",
716:                 len(pending_actions),
717:             )
718:             self._execute_actions(conversation, pending_actions, on_event)
719:             return
720: 
721:         # Check if the last user message was blocked by a UserPromptSubmit hook
722:         # If so, skip processing and mark conversation as finished
723:         if state.last_user_message_id is not None:
724:             reason = state.pop_blocked_message(state.last_user_message_id)
725:             if reason is not None:
726:                 logger.info(f"User message blocked by hook: {reason}")
727:                 state.execution_status = ConversationExecutionStatus.FINISHED
728:                 return
729:         elif state.blocked_messages:
730:             logger.debug(
731:                 "Blocked messages exist but last_user_message_id is None; "
732:                 "skipping hook check for legacy conversation state."
733:             )
734: 
735:         # Build per-conversation context once and thread it through all
736:         # LLM calls in this step (avoids shared mutable state on the LLM).
737:         call_context: LLMCallContext = conversation.get_llm_call_context()
738: 
739:         # Establish route-aware runtime metadata (cached, no I/O on a hit)
740:         # before the condenser decides a token threshold, so a routed model's
741:         # real endpoint limit drives condensation on the first step.
742:         self.llm.resolve_runtime_metadata()
743: 
744:         # Prepare LLM messages from the cached, incrementally-maintained view.
745:         # See https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/3053.
746:         _messages_or_condensation = prepare_llm_messages(
747:             state.view, condenser=self.condenser, llm=self.llm
748:         )
749: 
750:         # Process condensation event before agent sampels another action
751:         if isinstance(_messages_or_condensation, Condensation):
752:             on_event(_messages_or_condensation)
753:             return
754: 
755:         _messages = _messages_or_condensation
756: 
757:         if _should_handle_non_multimodal_image_input(self.llm, _messages):
